title: The Happy Stupid Kid Show
description: Unfortunately canceled due to parental controversy, Wooldoor Sockbat welcomes kids of all races and creeds, sisters and brothers, and every personality.
quote: With tolerance and love, we’re all free to be!
altHero: Wooldoor Sockbat with a white boy, Black girl, and Asian boy in a wheelchair
alt1: Sockbat scrunching the cheeks of the girl
alt2: Sockbat pushing the boy in his wheelchair
